recordFormat: newline-delimited JSON; one JSON object per responsive scanned target or target error; non-responsive targets with no result evidence are omitted

keyPolicy.case: lowerCamelCase for all emitted object keys
keyPolicy.legacyKeyPolicy: snake_case, dotted, and abbreviated source keys are normalized at JSON serialization boundaries
keyPolicy.canonicalTokenPolicy: Delimited key tokens cred, fw, mfr, postauth, and preauth are normalized during lower-camel normalization to credential, firmwareVersion, manufacturer, postAuth, and preAuth. The creds abbreviation is preserved as Creds.
keyPolicy.multiValueStringPolicy: fields that compact multiple scalar values into one field use sorted, de-duplicated CSV with no spaces after commas
keyPolicy.majorCollections: arrays of objects remain arrays: findings, identity.signals, rakp, ipmiPostAuth.cipherMatrix, ipmiPostAuth.setPrivAttempts, ipmiPostAuth.users, and ipmiPostAuth.fru
keyPolicy.dynamicObjectPolicy: identity.attributes, finalIdentity.flags, ipmiPostAuth.lan, ipmiPostAuth.lan6, and findings[].fields are dynamic objects whose keys are canonicalized with the same lowerCamelCase policy

fields.description: Target host as supplied to the scan pipeline, usually an IP address or hostname.
Unix timestamp in nanoseconds when the target result was emitted.
Discovered open surface. Keys are port/transport pairs; values are sorted CSV protocol labels observed on that port.
Best identity from pre-check fingerprinting. Used to select applicable checks.
Lowercase vendor slug.
Evidence signals used by identify.
Additional identity attributes. Keys are normalized lowerCamelCase; values are strings. Known multi-value attributes such as wsmanSecurityProfiles use sorted CSV.
Post-check aggregate identity and exposure summary. Present when finalization ran.
Firmware or software version selected from identity attributes.
Derived exposure flags. Keys are camelCase flag names; values are the highest risk backing the flag.
Count of findings with risk >= info on the host.
Most severe risk observed on the host.
Positive findings. Clean risk=none findings are aggregated into attemptedChecks instead of remaining here.
Stable finding/check identifier.
Unix timestamp in nanoseconds for the finding.
Check-specific details. Keys are normalized lowerCamelCase and values are strings. Known multi-value field values are sorted CSV.
Sorted CSV of CVE identifiers associated with the finding.
Check duration in seconds when recorded.
Sorted CSV of checks that ran and emitted only clean risk=none results.
Per-service raw attribute bags. Preserves the crypto material and runZero-vocabulary service data a consumer needs to re-score exposure without re-probing.
Port the service was observed on.
Transport the service was observed on.
Sorted protocol labels observed on the service.
Service summary line. Never set by a live scan; carried through by oobscan convert from a runZero export.
Virtual host the service answered for. Convert-only, as with services[].summary.
Address the service was observed on when it differs from the record host. Convert-only, as with services[].summary.
runZero-vocabulary attribute bag for the service (tls.*, ssh.*, http.*, ipmi.*, fp.*), most importantly the badkeys hashes tls.fp.bkhash and ssh.hostKey.bkhash.
Host-level attributes: resolved class/vendor/product/version plus any captured identity attributes. oobscan convert additionally carries a source asset's own columns and attribute bag through here.
Pre-auth HPE iLO /xmldata?item=all RIMP document, verbatim. Emitted whenever the iLO probe parsed a populated doc. Previously evidence-only, so MP.PN/MP.ST never reached the output.
Host system product name. The only pre-auth source of the server model on iLOs that do not expose Redfish.
HPE product part number.
Chassis serial number (HSI/SBSN).
iLO chassis UUID. Distinct from the Redfish Manager UUID in identity.attributes.redfishUuid.
Chassis cUUID when present.
Pre-auth per-port NIC inventory (port, description, location, macAddress, ipAddress, status). Unauthenticated host/iLO MAC and configured IP disclosure.
Management processor product string (MP/PN). One of the two inputs to iLO generation resolution.

Management processor family code (MP/ST): 5=iLO2, 6=iLO3, 7=iLO4, 8=iLO5, 9=iLO6. The second input to generation resolution; serialized so a fall-through to a bare "iLO" is diagnosable without a re-scan.
iLO firmware version (MP/FWRI).
iLO hardware revision (MP/HWRI).
iLO serial number (MP/SN).
Management processor UUID (MP/UUID).
Single sign-on state (MP/SSO).
Advertised locfg.pl scripting endpoint (MP/LOCFG).
Enclosure bay number for blade-housed iLOs.
Enclosure rack name.
Enclosure serial number.
Raw RAKP-2 material for offline cracking. Emitted when IPMI auth evidence exists.
IPMI RAKP auth algorithm number: 1=HMAC-SHA1, 2=HMAC-MD5, 3=HMAC-SHA256.
Ready-to-crack hashcat -m 7300 line for HMAC-SHA1 RAKP hashes.
Recovered password when offline cracking succeeded during scan.
The source withheld this row's salt and HMAC rather than never capturing them. Set only by oobscan convert on a runZero export; a live scan leaves it unset.
Authenticated IPMI inventory captured after a valid default credential, authNone, or cipherZero flow.
Authentication path used for the IPMI post-auth inventory.
IPMI 1.5 auth type byte.
IPMI 2.0 cipher-suite algorithm triple.
IPMI confidentiality algorithm byte.
Results from probing post-auth RMCP+ cipher suites.
Observed Set Session Privilege Level probe outcomes from the authenticated IPMI 2.0 session.
Requested IPMI privilege level byte.
IPMI completion code returned by the privilege request.
Granted privilege level byte when the BMC returned one.
Parsed IPMI Get Device ID data.
Parsed chassis status.
Compact user-slot inventory.
IPv4 LAN channel parameters. Keys are normalized lowerCamelCase.
IPv6 LAN channel parameters. Keys are normalized lowerCamelCase.
Decoded FRU string fields.
Authenticated Redfish inventory captured after a valid credential, provided credential, or mTLS path.
Authenticated Redfish system/manager/service-root inventory.
Target-level scan error.
